Muscle Group: Posterior chain - hamstrings, glutes, spinal erectors, lats, grip
Cue List: Set the bar over mid-foot | Grip just outside the knees | Drop the hips, chest up, flatten the back | Take the slack out of the bar | Brace hard against the belt | Push the floor away, bar close to the shins | Stand tall, lock the hips, do not lean back | Return it the way it came up, hinge first
Bar on the shelf of the back, not the neck | Brace, then unrack and step back small | Break at the hips and knees together | Sit between your feet to depth | Drive the floor away and stand tall
Bar in the heel of the hand, elbows under | Squeeze the glutes, brace the trunk | Press up and move the head back through | Finish with the bar over the mid-foot

Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched down | Feet flat, drive them into the floor | Unrack to over the shoulders | Lower to the lower chest with control | Elbows tucked to about forty-five degrees | Touch, then press back and slightly toward the face | Lock out over the shoulders, not the throat

Muscle Group: Lats, rhomboids, mid-trapezius, rear deltoids, biceps
Cue List: Hinge to about parallel, flat back | Bar hangs under the shoulders | Pull the elbows past the ribs | Bring the bar to the lower ribs, not the chest | Squeeze the mid-back at the top | Lower under control, do not drop it

Bar high on the front of the shoulders | Elbows up, upper arms parallel to the floor | Light fingertip grip, keep the rack solid | Brace the trunk hard | Big breath, break at the knees first | Keep the elbows up as you descend | Sit to depth with the torso tall | Drive up, elbows stay high the whole time | Stand tall and reset the breath
